checks: source rows used for confirmation were not present in or derived from any prior XAU robustness, compatibility, historical-validation, attribution, or hypothesis-generation input
no direction or bias-persistence economics for the confirmation window were inspected before the protocol commit
instrument, provider, server, digits, point, timestamp normalization, row ordering, OHLC geometry, duplicate timestamps, and source gaps are verified
the frozen strategy replays deterministically with unchanged closed-candle, H4-priority, indicator-initialization, setup, entry, stop, exit, and R semantics
indicator warm-up is complete before confirmation eligibility and strategy setup, pending, and open-trade state is suppressed/reset before the confirmation start
the full fixed confirmation window is available without tuning, interpolation, threshold changes, or data-dependent extension
source identity and raw SHA-256 are frozen before any confirmatory economics are computed
admissibility_checks.failure_action: WAITING FOR UNTOUCHED DATA; do not compute or serialize confirmatory economics

candidate_data_source.required_acquisition: a new immutable XM GOLD M1 export containing the complete fixed confirmation window and rows strictly later than every row in the frozen discovery-used source

confirmation_window.exit_policy: only trades closed strictly before end_exclusive are closed; later-open trades are censored and excluded from closed-trade economics
confirmation_window.start_basis: exactly one M1 interval after the last normalized timestamp in the frozen discovery-used XM source; confirmation requires source rows at or after this boundary and no setup origin before it
confirmation_window.window_extension: PROHIBITED even when minimum samples are not reached

decision_authority: Sol/main only; protocol or result artifacts do not grant phase approval

h1.confirmed: all SHORT LOW, MEDIUM, and HIGH cells have at least 30 closed trades; HIGH expectancy is strictly greater than LOW expectancy and strictly greater than MEDIUM expectancy; and HIGH expectancy minus pooled LOW+MEDIUM expectancy is at least 0.25686195796715366R
h1.inconclusive: any required SHORT cell has fewer than 30 closed trades, or the ordering is mixed, or the ordering is positive but the retained magnitude is below 0.25686195796715366R
h1.magnitude_rule: retain at least 50% of the frozen discovery HIGH-minus-pooled-LOW+MEDIUM contrast; this is a predeclared stability criterion, not an optimized threshold
h1.not_confirmed: all required SHORT cells have at least 30 closed trades and HIGH expectancy is less than or equal to pooled LOW+MEDIUM expectancy, or HIGH is less than or equal to both LOW and MEDIUM
h1.pooled_low_medium_expectancy: (LOW total R + MEDIUM total R) / (LOW closed trades + MEDIUM closed trades)

h2.directional_parity_small_difference: both direction cells have at least 30 closed trades and absolute LONG-minus-SHORT expectancy difference is at most 0.10R
h2.insufficient_sample: LONG or SHORT has fewer than 30 closed trades
h2.long_advantage_reproduced: both direction cells have at least 30 closed trades and LONG-minus-SHORT expectancy difference is greater than 0.10R
h2.production_authority: H2 alone never authorizes a directional modification
h2.short_advantage: both direction cells have at least 30 closed trades and LONG-minus-SHORT expectancy difference is less than -0.10R

direction_definitions.directional_expectancy_difference: LONG expectancy R minus SHORT expectancy R
direction_definitions.directional_total_r_difference: LONG total R minus SHORT total R
direction_definitions.long_short: the unchanged frozen StrategyEvent/OpenTrade Direction values

forbidden_analyses: SHORT-only-when-HIGH or any direction-by-persistence rule backtest
persistence definition, boundary, lookback, threshold, merge, or relabel changes
new regime families or ATR, HEMA geometry, Kalman recency, calendar, or volatility filters
entry, exit, stop, TP, RR, strategy parameter, or production market changes
resampling, cross-validation, bootstrap, or redissection of discovery data presented as independent confirmation
data-dependent window extension or minimum-sample reduction

h1.name: Direction x 4H Bias Persistence Interaction
h1.predeclared_direction: SHORT HIGH expectancy exceeds SHORT LOW expectancy, SHORT MEDIUM expectancy, and pooled SHORT LOW+MEDIUM expectancy
h1.question: On genuinely untouched XAU data, is SHORT performance materially stronger in frozen HIGH 4H bias persistence than in frozen LOW and MEDIUM persistence?

h2.name: Broad Directional Asymmetry Stability
h2.question: On genuinely untouched XAU data, what is LONG expectancy minus SHORT expectancy?
h2.scope: confirmatory descriptive classification only; no direction may be disabled

exclude: all rows from the exact frozen one-million-row XM extraction as confirmation observations
all March-August-2026 TradingView and XM compatibility observations
all data used in XAU robustness, market transfer, compatibility, historical validation, attribution, or hypothesis generation
trades not closed strictly before 2027-03-01T23:00:00Z from closed-trade metrics
include: setup origins at or after 2026-08-28T20:58:00Z and strictly before 2027-03-01T23:00:00Z from an admitted source
the unchanged exhaustive eligible setup paths immediate_open, armed_then_opened, and armed_then_cancelled
opened trades whose setup origin is included
closed trades whose canonical exit is finalized strictly before the fixed end-exclusive timestamp

missing_data_policy.bucket_missing: retain and report an explicit missing bucket; never impute a persistence value; missing is contextual and is not a primary H1 cell
missing_data_policy.ohlc: reject malformed, duplicate, non-monotonic, non-finite, or invalid-geometry rows; do not interpolate missing bars
missing_data_policy.provider_gaps: report every non-modal gap and accept only gaps explained by verified XM maintenance/session closure semantics; otherwise the source is inadmissible
missing_data_policy.trade_outcome: censor trades without a canonical exit strictly before the fixed end; never impute R

multiple_testing_statement: Exactly two predeclared hypotheses are evaluated. H1 is primary and H2 is secondary descriptive. No alternative persistence thresholds, bucketings, regime families, subperiod searches, or multiplicity-driven follow-up tests are permitted.
no_tuning_statement: No strategy, XAU parameter, persistence definition, persistence boundary, confirmation window, sample threshold, friction assumption, entry, exit, stop, or direction rule may be tuned after this protocol is frozen.

persistence_freeze.binning: LOW when value <= 39.75; MEDIUM when 39.75 < value <= 116.5; HIGH when value > 116.5; otherwise MISSING
persistence_freeze.discovery_derivation_record: combined eligible setup-only type-7 tertiles with q1=39.75 hours and q2=116.5 hours; ties remain in the lower-inclusive bucket
persistence_freeze.lookahead: setup-origin post_state only; no future information

directional_differences: LONG expectancy R minus SHORT expectancy R
LONG total R minus SHORT total R
primary_metrics.persistence_reporting: SHORT LOW, MEDIUM, and HIGH are primary H1 cells; LONG in the same buckets and MISSING for both directions are contextual

protocol_lock.serialization: canonical JSON with sort_keys=true, compact separators, UTF-8, terminal newline

provider_compatibility_requirements.aggregation: deterministic M1-to-M15/H4 aggregation inherited unchanged; incomplete interval policy unchanged
provider_compatibility_requirements.preferred_source: same XM GOLD instrument/server/digits/point identity as discovery, but newly acquired rows outside the frozen source
provider_compatibility_requirements.strategy_semantics: canonical replay must remain unchanged and pass existing XM compatibility, chronological no-lookahead, and source-integrity checks
provider_compatibility_requirements.timestamp: XM labeled timestamps must normalize to UTC using the already verified server-time semantics; no shifted or nearest timestamp matching
provider_compatibility_requirements.unrelated_provider: inadmissible under this v1 protocol; an independent provider would require its own separately committed source-admission protocol before economics

statistical_treatment.confidence_intervals: not required; no new inferential machinery is introduced
statistical_treatment.evidence_type: deterministic descriptive independent confirmation with locked ordering, adequacy, and magnitude rules

strategy_version.frozen_behavior: exact canonical closed-candle chronology, H4 priority, Pine-equivalent indicators and initialization, setup paths, cancellation, entry, stop, exit, and R accounting

all_conditions: not previously used to generate H1 or H2
no directional or persistence economics previously inspected
not present in any data input used by XAU robustness, market transfer, compatibility, historical validation, attribution, or hypothesis generation
deterministically replayable with verifiable timestamp/provider semantics and sufficient fixed warm-up
usable without tuning or post-result admission changes
untouched_data_definition.scientific_boundary: candidate confirmation observations must be newly acquired rows with normalized timestamps strictly greater than 2026-08-28T20:57:00Z

warmup_rules.indicator_history: prior bars may initialize recursive indicators and the 4H bias epoch, but they are context only and never confirmation observations
warmup_rules.strategy_state: suppress/reset setup, pending, and open-trade state before confirmation eligibility; no setup origin or trade may carry into the window
